channel.title: DER/32 news
channel.description: News from the DER/32 project, a NetBSD-derived UNIX.

item.title: In testing: NetBSD binary packages on DER/32
item.description: DER/32 keeps the NetBSD 10 ABI, so NetBSD's pkgsrc binary packages can install unmodified under /usr/pkg. Support via pkg_add and pkgin is being tested.

item.title: DER/32 0.1 “Genesis” boots
item.description: The first development release builds on Arch Linux and boots to a login prompt as a disk image and as a live ISO.
